column1: # Lexeme class `collective` (docs/LEXICON_FORMAT_ES.md §9 in the engine repo): nouns that name a group
# or a quantity of people or things. Rules: `[class=collective]`, `[class:collective=part|quantity]`.
# Columns: lemma[:sense]  pos  value. Values: group, part, quantity, numeral, kind.
# Written from own knowledge of Spanish (clean-room); only lemmas of this lexicon.
